proof_audit.review: Complete indicator proof: marginal inclusion 1/2, pair inclusion 1/6, covariance -1/12, independent strata, full expansion to finite baseline sample variance. Two-person pair-variance averaging proves the stated Neyman expectation under constant within-stratum effects. The manuscript does not claim exact Gaussian studentization or extend that equality proof to general heterogeneous effects.

Tied extremeness groups prove P(p<=alpha)<=alpha for the declared finite law. The sharp zero null imputes each missing potential; a weak average null does not. Complement reflection implies minimum inclusive two-sided p 1/18 and zero rejection probability at 1/20 without unassigned randomized tie-breaking.

The selected direction is defined for every assignment, including positive at zero. Calibrating the lower tail of the selected p replays the full rule. Complement symmetry and monotonicity in magnitude establish equality with the absolute-score test in this orbit, including truncation at one for the zero tie. No universal two-times correction is asserted.

An independent conceptual uniform frame index I and whole balanced assignment Z define finite one-person expectations. Conditional expectation cancels participation and treatment factors; identification of levels uses two separate potential-level mean assumptions plus support. Balanced counts prove both treatment denominators exactly 24; the ratio identity is not generalized to random denominators.

Common shifts move both target levels while preserving effects. Positive-weight rectangular extrema are attained at corners; interpolation proves sharpness. The unsupported-cell target is a separate finite-support law, with explicit endpoint potential pairs and their mixtures. These are population assumption sets, not sample confidence intervals.

A different auditor receives only retained records and bounded integer cents, excluding all prior values, derived full-data outputs and teacher restrictions. The statistic is affine in cents. Each absolute comparison reduces to c>=9 or a threshold w<=(-c-9)/2. All classes and inclusive boundaries are enumerated after the algebra, yielding a 1201-point statistic lattice and five p-values. Continuous relaxation, discrete completion and causal identification remain distinct.

resolved_design_findings.resolution: Use the exact lattice and call [9/4,21/4] its sharp envelope; the explicitly continuous relaxation fills that interval. Root confirmed this refinement. The five p-value regions are the same under both domains.
Named P0–P4 branch contracts and relative-day run log explicitly prevent attaching P0/P2 inference to P1’s statistic. Root required this separation.
Define conceptual independent I and whole randomized Z explicitly. Transport expectation is over (I,Z); trial-estimator uncertainty is over the dependent balanced vector Z.
Keep 25/12 and 21/4 in distinct laws; observed Neyman 5/8 is legitimate but does not supply an exact normal tail. The Fisher p tests sharp zero, not a weak average null.
Record all five exact regions and the comparison-class formula; do not claim all real p values between 1/18 and 4/9 occur.

Define a separate access-world auditor and expressly exclude those records and numerical disclosures. Every candidate completion uses only retained records and stated bounds and need not preserve the complete dossier’s hidden oracle. This implements the coordinator’s information-boundary clarification without changing any numerical result.
